goal: Migrate the checkout module from Vue 2 to Vue 3 without changing its public API.
constraints: must not change the public API of the shared ui package

priorDecisions.decision: Use the Vue 3 Composition API for all new composables
priorDecisions.rationale: Matches the rest of the codebase post-migration

priorDecisions.decision: Only packages/web/src/checkout is in scope. Leave packages/legacy alone.
priorDecisions.rationale: Answered by the operator when asked: “Which packages does the migration cover?”

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All existing checkout unit tests pass unmodified.
No v-model modifier is silently dropped by the codemod.
The checkout flow renders identically in a manual pass.
acceptanceCriteria.reason: Subjective. No visual-diff harness exists yet; route to a human node at the end of the milestone.

knownFailureModes.description: the migration codemod silently drops v-model modifiers
knownFailureModes.detection: diff the compiled template output before and after the codemod
knownFailureModes.mitigation: add a lint rule that flags any v-model without a matching modifier in the diff
